name: Makira Starling
rangeDescription: Makira (southeastern solomon islands)
description: A rather small, entirely dark starling with a glossy-blue sheen to the head and a more purple sheen elsewhere. Wings and tail are a dull matte earth-brown.

name: Black-backed Tody-Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Humid foothills of southeastern peru (cusco and puno)
description: Tiny, boldly-colored flycatcher. Compact and short-tailed; yellow below, black above, with a white throat and mustache, and small red shoulder patch.

name: Cebu Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Cebu (central philippines); rediscovered 1992 after 85 years but no recent records; perhaps extinct
description: A tiny bird of foothill forest on Cebu, very rare and possibly extinct. Male has whitish upperparts, black upperparts, a red back, and an orange rump.

name: Salvin's Curassow
rangeDescription: Humid lowlands of southern colombia to eastern ecuador and northeastern peru
description: Large black curassow with a bright red bill, white lower belly, and white tail tip. Unlikely to be confused.

name: Chinese Grouse
rangeDescription: Mountains of western china (gansu to eastern tibet, northwestern yunnan, and northern sichuan)
description: A stout, crested terrestrial bird of mountainous woodlands and the only grouse in its range. Brown overall, with densely patterned belly.

name: Mountain Sawwing
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern nigeria and southwestern cameroon; bioko
description: An entirely brownish-black swallow with darker wings and a forked tail. Often encountered in groups at the forest edge and in montane grassland.

name: Horned Screamer
rangeDescription: Lowlands of venezuela to northern bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Enormous, ungainly ogre of a bird. Found around freshwater marshes and rivers in Amazonian lowlands.

name: Black-browed Barbet
rangeDescription: Montane forest of malay peninsula and sumatra
description: Loud but sluggish and difficult-to-see canopy inhabitant of highland forests in peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra. Note the leaf-green body, brightly colored face, and heavy black bill.

name: Graceful Pitta
rangeDescription: Highlands of sumatra
description: Rare and secretive jewel of the Sumatran highlands. Found at 400-1400 meters in wet forest, especially in gullies and ravines.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Scarlet-collared Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (mindoro)
description: A small bird of lowland and foothill forest and more open wooded areas on Mindoro, slightly glossy black with a white belly and sides of the chest and with red patches on the throat, upper back, and in a stripe from the center of the chest down the belly. Note the fairly long, thin, slightly curved bill.

name: Tristram's Storm-Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds and ranges hawaii, izu, and volcano islands
description: Dark brown, fork-tailed seabird of the northwestern and central Pacific, where it breeds on Japanese and Hawaiian islands. Generally forages far offshore and does not associate with boats.

name: Pemba Scops-Owl
rangeDescription: Pemba island (off northeastern tanzania)
description: A large scops-owl that is endemic to the Tanzanian island of Pemba. A fairly plain owl with small ear tufts.

name: South Georgia Shag
rangeDescription: South georgia, south sandwich, and south orkney islands
description: Learn about Imperial Cormorant (South Georgia): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.

name: Gray-capped Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Northern colombia and northern venezuela; migrates to western peru
description: Brightly-colored cuckoo found mainly west of the Andes. Combination of rufous-tawny body and gray separates it from other cuckoos in range.

name: Wakatobi White-eye
rangeDescription: Wakatobi (tukangbesi) islands, southeast of sulawesi
description: Bright yellowish white-eye found only on the Tukangbesi Islands off southeastern Sulawesi. Common to abundant in open coastal forest, forest edge, scrubby areas, gardens, plantations, and towns.

name: Chatham Islands Pigeon
rangeDescription: Chatham islands
description: Only large pigeon on the Chatham Islands. Shows a distinctive white belly and maroon-tinged upper wings.

name: Clarion Wren
rangeDescription: Clarion island (revillagigedo islands off western mexico)
description: This wren is found only on Clarión Island, which is located in the Pacific Ocean about 450 miles southwest of the tip of Baja California in Mexico. It is warm brown with slightly paler underparts, bars on the wings and tail, faint streaks on the face, and a pale eyering.

name: White-chested Puffbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to eastern peru, the guianas, and western amazonian brazil
description: Brown-and-white streaked bird with a large head and yellowish bill; white crescent on chest is helpful for identification but can be difficult to see. Inhabits lower and middle levels of tall rainforest, where it is easily overlooked as it sits motionless for long periods before darting to tree trunks, foliage, or ground for large insect and small vertebrate prey.

name: Feline Owlet-nightjar
rangeDescription: Mountains of new guinea (bird's head peninsula to southeastern new guinea)
description: A large owlet-nightjar of montane rainforest interior. Outlandish and unique appearance.

name: Salvadori's Teal
rangeDescription: Mountain streams of new guinea
description: An unusual duck of alpine lakes and mountain streams. Very distinctive elongated shape with yellow bill, dark head, strong barring on the body and a pointy tail which is cocked when startled.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography
